title: College Outcomes Comparison
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Compare retention, four-year, and six-year graduation rates for up to four colleges, and see which gaps are a reason to ask questions.

learningObjectives: Students will compare retention and graduation rates across colleges and assess which differences signal a reason to investigate further.
prerequisites: Chapter 4: Researching and Narrowing Your College List

controls: College name and three rate inputs per row

keyQuestions: Why can a college with a solid six-year graduation rate still be expensive to finish?
What questions would you ask on a visit to a college with low retention?
Why should you compare rates from the same source?
commonMisconceptions: Most students finish college in four years.
A low graduation rate always means a bad college.
assessmentOpportunities: Students identify which flagged differences warrant further investigation and write one question to ask each college about its outcomes.
